pages.text: Sink it in a $(l)lava lake$(): it catches Magmafish and lava treasures on its own. The more lava around, the faster; $(item)raw meat$() as bait doubles the speed. Works with hoppers.
$(item)Magmafish Scale$() + $(item)Awkward Potion$() = $(l)Potion of Lava Diving$(): Fire Resistance and $(l)Lava Vision$() (see clearly and swim fast in lava). Redstone extends it.
pages.title: Plongée en lave
